description: History of film, major movements, directors, and cinematic traditions across cultures

film_history.invention: Lumière brothers; 1895 Paris; first public film screening; Workers Leaving the Lumière Factory
film_history.silent_era: 1895–1927; no synchronized sound; intertitles and music
film_history.first_sound: The Jazz Singer (1927); first synchronized sound feature

german_expressionism.characteristics: Distorted sets, high contrast, dark themes, shadow play

italian_neorealism.characteristics: Non-professional actors, real locations, social issues, post-war Italy

french_new_wave.characteristics: Jump cuts, handheld camera, improvisation, self-awareness

new_hollywood.characteristics: Director-driven, dark themes, anti-heroes, European influence

bollywood.characteristics: Song-and-dance numbers, melodrama, family themes, 3+ hours
bollywood.output: 1,500+ films/year; world's largest film industry by number of films

iranian.awards: Farhadi won two Oscars for Best Foreign Film

korean.milestone: Parasite (2019); first non-English film to win Best Picture Oscar

chinese_fifth_generation.characteristics: Visual spectacle, historical epics, allegory of Cultural Revolution

essential_films.citizen_kane: Orson Welles (1941); innovative cinematography; frequently tops best-of lists
essential_films.2001_space_odyssey: Stanley Kubrick (1968); practical effects; AI and evolution
essential_films.seven_samurai: Kurosawa (1954); influenced countless westerns and action films

major_film_festivals.cannes: France; Palme d'Or; most prestigious; founded 1946
major_film_festivals.oscars: Academy Awards; USA; most globally known; since 1929
